tasks.prompt: Formalize: for odd positive x define T(x)=(3x+1)/2^v2(3x+1). State precisely what constitutes an odd cycle of length N.
Given x_i odd and 2^a_i x_{i+1}=3x_i+1 around a length-N cycle, derive the exact product identity relating x_0, A=sum a_i, and powers of 2 and 3.
A proposed lemma says every accelerated Collatz step decreases an odd integer. Find a counterexample and explain why it refutes the lemma but not the Collatz conjecture.
Compute T(27) exactly under the accelerated odd map and show the valuation used.
Audit the inference: verified for all odd x below 10^9, therefore true for all odd positive integers. Identify the exact logical error.

Classify each as PROOF, FINITE COMPUTATION, NECESSARY CONDITION, or CONJECTURE: exhaustive search to B; an algebraic identity valid for every cycle; a heuristic random-walk model; a divisibility condition every cycle must satisfy.
Write a compact research checkpoint separating established results, computational evidence, open gap, and next decisive test for a hypothetical cycle-exclusion campaign.
